proposed_title: Plan, authorize and monitor livestock grazing on shared rangelands

rationale: No v1 home: gold items S278, S040, S062 had only weak fits; NMF cluster of 641 low-similarity USFS components on range/livestock/forage/allotments. Module candidate (public-lands / rangeland) rather than core. DB/FC to confirm

proposed_title: Plan and manage recreation opportunity and visitor use
description: Allocate recreation opportunity spectrum classes, designate motorized and non-motorized routes, manage capacity and use conflicts, and maintain recreation facilities to class standards
rationale: Gold items S224, S231, S054 weak; cluster of 533 components (motorized; semi-primitive; ROS; routes; travel). v1 has trail construction and visitor information but not recreation planning or travel management

proposed_title: Assess and design for scenic resources
description: Apply scenic integrity or visual quality objectives to project design and evaluation, including viewshed analysis from critical viewing platforms
rationale: Gold items S182, S259, S061 had no adequate v1 competency; cluster of 482 components (scenic integrity; wild and scenic river corridors; visual)

proposed_title: Plan, maintain and decommission resource road and trail transportation systems
description: Locate, design, maintain, close or obliterate roads to minimize resource effects, applying BMPs and travel analysis
rationale: Gold items S221 (weak) and S197 (linker failed: road obliteration matched watershed hydrology only at low score); cluster of 419 components on road construction, reconstruction and access
